new_final.message: Writes through a caller-supplied property path without rejecting the `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` segments, so a crafted path reaches Object.prototype (prototype pollution).
This assignment may alter Object.prototype if a malicious '__proto__' string is injected from [library input](1).
